::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1862]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. This fragment printed in Mary J. Y. Harris, <i>[Memoirs of Frances Mary Peard](other_books/otherbook_318.qmd)</i>, 1903. 48.
:::

Many thanks for this beautiful paper which will beautifully finish off the year .... [Your](people/person_1160.qmd) references are all so full and so clear that they make the [papers](organizations/other_81.qmd) all the more useful, and I always find myself glad when I have one to read with my class which is after all the best test.
